## Main course themes

:::: {.phase-grid role="list" aria-label="Main MGenética course themes"}
::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**01 · Foundations**

Study blocks M1 and M2: basic genetics and modes of gene action.

[Start M01](modulo01-revisao-de-genetica-basica.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Abrir módulo"}
:::

::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**02 · Population genetics**

Study blocks M3 to M5: frequencies, Hardy-Weinberg and forces that change alleles.

[Start M03](modulo03-genetica-de-populacoes-i-frequencias-alelicas-e-genotipicas.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Abrir módulo"}
:::

::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**03 · Quantitative genetics**

Study blocks M6 to M12: phenotype, variance, heritability, selection and correlations.

[Start M06](modulo06-valores-e-medias-fenotipo-genotipo-e-ambiente.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Abrir módulo"}
:::

::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**04 · Relationship, crossbreeding and genetic evaluation**

Study blocks M13 to M17: inbreeding, heterosis, EBV/DEP, mixed models and BLUP.

[Start M13](modulo13-endogamia-e-parentesco.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Abrir módulo"}
:::

::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**05 · Applied genomics**

Markers, quality control, matrices, GWAS, prediction and final project.

[Start M18](modulo18-genomica-marcadores-snp-e-dados-moleculares.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Abrir módulo"}
:::
::::
